newsitem.title: USA: Actor Chris Lemmon arrested after New York fight.
newsitem.headline: Actor Chris Lemmon arrested after New York fight.

text.p: Chris Lemmon, the actor son of Oscar-winning actor Jack Lemmon, was arrested Tuesday afternoon for fighting with another man after a Manhattan traffic accident, police said.

The 43-year-old Lemmon, who lives in Connecticut, was charged with third-degree assault and criminal mischief for kicking and denting the car of John Nicotish, 31, of Manhattan, police spokeswoman Cheryl Cox said.
Lemmon, in a sport utility vehicle, rear-ended Nicotish's car, Cox said.
"They had a vehicle accident, a fender-bender, and they got out and they each hit each other," she said. "They had an argument and it escalated."
Nicotish was charged with third-degree assault and possession of marijuana, Cox said.
The younger Lemmon starred in the television series "Thunder in Paradise," "Duet" and "Open House" and has appeared in about half a dozen movies.
